approvalNote: Reviewed side by side against ref.png at full size, plus the composition and overflow gates. Structure, hierarchy, reading order and every departure from the source confirmed against the template's own header notes. This is a MACHINE approval: no human has read these against the bank. Treat it as a gate that has been honestly passed, not as sign-off by the deck owner. CAVEAT: A brand photo stands in for the source's image.

children.note: --at, a percentage. An editorial claim, not a layout value.

invariants: The dot position IS content. 45% and 70% on the same pair say different things, and the number should be argued about like any other claim.
The media half carries a scrim. White type over a photograph whose brightness the deck cannot predict is a §3.5 failure waiting to happen.
The quote is set flat. The source skews it, which the type system does not sanction and which costs legibility for nothing.
Furniture over the dark half inverts. It is a sibling of the right column, not a child — a descendant selector silently matches nothing.
